concept: Handshake in a sunstruck industrial courtyard
creativeDirection: Daylight location photography stages the sleeve portraits and collage motifs as real objects in a crisp industrial yard, using hard midday sun to keep the image bright, graphic, and physically plausible.
scene: A wide 16:9 view into a clean concrete industrial courtyard bordered by pale walls and exposed steel structures, photographed from slightly below eye level so the foreground figures feel monumental while the surrounding objects and architectural details spread outward in clear space.

elements.element: The woman from reference image 1 is the primary foreground subject, framed from the chest up and facing the camera in her light blue halter top with the same direct pose, short dark hair, and expression; the two men from reference image 1 stand behind her in softer but still readable focus, one to the left in his multicolored top with the small topknot and one to the right in a blue shirt holding a large angular grey object.

The two men from reference image 2 appear midground at one side of the courtyard, locked in their handshake in dark suits, with one man visibly edged with controlled flame; the off-white collage field becomes the pale courtyard walls, while supporting details are transformed into real environmental features: rainbow safety stripes painted across a low barrier, a green waveform line as a painted conduit or mural, a blue circular skylight-like sign with clouds, a framed desert billboard with pyramids and a tiny pink pig balloon above it, a pink marbled disc mounted on a wall, red rubble and smokestack forms beyond the yard, and blue angular beam structures integrated into the architecture.

coverSummaries.description: A soft-focus photographic portrait of three people against a smooth blue background. In the foreground, a woman with very short dark hair and dark lipstick faces the camera, wearing a light blue halter-style top. Behind her are two men, both slightly blurred; one stands to the right in a blue shirt holding a large angular grey object, and the other stands to the left in a multicolored top with a small topknot or tuft of hair. The composition centers on the woman’s face and shoulders, with the other two figures receding into the background.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: close-up of a short-haired woman in a blue halter top
coverSummaries.people: three people: one woman in front facing the camera, with two men blurred behind her

coverSummaries.description: A collage-style image on an off-white background combining multiple cutout pictures and graphic shapes. Near the bottom center, two men in suits shake hands, one figure appearing partially engulfed in flames. Along the lower area is a red-toned industrial scene with rubble and smokestacks, overlaid by horizontal rainbow bands and green heartbeat-like waveform lines. Elsewhere are a blue circular sky image with clouds, a framed desert scene with pyramids and a small pink pig floating above it, a pink circular marbled image, and a blue-toned architectural or industrial structure made of angular beams and repeating columns. The elements are scattered across the page with ample empty space between them.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: two suited men shaking hands, one on fire
coverSummaries.medium: mixed-media collage with photographic cutouts and graphic overlays
coverSummaries.people: two men in suits shaking hands

prompt: A wide industrial courtyard under hard midday sun, viewed slightly below eye level with crisp shadows and clear open space; the woman from reference image 1 dominates the foreground, framed chest-up and facing the camera exactly as in her source portrait, wearing the same light blue halter top with the same short dark hair, dark lipstick, direct gaze, and calm expression, while the two men from reference image 1 stand behind her in the same relative arrangement, one at left in his multicolored top with the small topknot and one at right in a blue shirt holding a large angular grey object. At midground to one side, the two men from reference image 2 perform their handshake in dark suits, one partially engulfed in believable controlled flames. Integrate the rest of reference image 2 into the location as real features: pale off-white courtyard walls, blue angular steel beams and repeating industrial columns, a low red rubble zone and distant smokestacks beyond the yard, horizontal rainbow bands painted across a barrier, a green heartbeat waveform as a wall graphic or conduit line, a circular sky sign showing blue sky and clouds, a framed desert billboard with pyramids and a small pink pig balloon floating above it, and a mounted pink marbled disc. Daylight location photography, clean realistic editorial treatment, sharp detail, no collage look, no haze, no rain, no glossy reflections. Strong visual hierarchy with the woman from reference image 1 as the anchor, the handshake from reference image 2 as the secondary focal point, and the remaining motifs distributed as supporting architectural details. Saturated blues, off-white, concrete grey, red industrial accents, rainbow stripes, and touches of green and pink; bright, surreal, confident mood. Reference map for people (the album images are attached in this numbered order): reference image 1 shows three people: one woman in front facing the camera, with two men blurred behind her; reference image 2 shows two men in suits shaking hands. Copy each of these faces directly from that numbered reference image - same face, hair, expression, and styling - rather than drawing a new person from the description. Hard constraints (override any conflicting source material): Create a single cohesive 16:9 image, not a grid, contact sheet, row of covers, or collage of separate panels. Do not reproduce the album sleeves as framed thumbnails; transform their non-text visual motifs into one original composition. Include no readable text or lettering of any kind: no words, letters, numbers, code, glyphs, captions, titles, logos, watermarks, labels, or signage. Feature only adults and avoid gore, wounds, body horror, medical or anatomical imagery, blank or milky eyes, nudity, sexual content, weapons, and hate symbols; reinterpret any sensitive source motif abstractly. When a source includes a person, closely match their visible appearance and likeness to the reference image, preserving recognisable facial features, hair, skin tone, clothing, and styling. Keep each reference person in the pose, expression, and gaze the sleeve shows, and keep every identifiable face sharp, lit, unobscured, and in focus: no motion blur, long-exposure smearing, steam, fog, shadow, crowding, or shallow depth of field over a reference person's face. Expose the image brightly and cleanly: open, readable shadows and clear colour, with no murky underexposure, crushed blacks, heavy film grain, digital noise, or dust-and-scratches texture. Depict each identifiable reference person only once in the entire composition; do not repeat or clone them as another figure, reflection, mirror portrait, poster, billboard, screen, photograph, painting, silhouette, or background face. The only exception is repetition visibly intrinsic to one source cover: keep that repetition within that single source motif and do not echo the person elsewhere.
